name: resources
title: Resource pages
description: A second kind of page (guides, handouts, checklists) with its own file names, home group and filter, and no review progress by default.

kinds.description: Page kinds to add. Each is a kind definition (same keys as site.json "kinds"). A kind already defined in site.json wins.

homeFilter.description: When home.filters is "auto", filter the home page by kind (main pages vs resources) instead of by group.

titleFormat.description: Browser title for resource pages (the site default uses the page number).
